event_check: The 424B4 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2093536/000119312526159369/d81728d424b4.htm, cover dated 'April 15, 2026', filed 2026-04-16) binds directors, officers and substantially all holders 'for a period of 180 days after the date of this prospectus (the restricted period)', waivable by two of Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley and Jefferies; no earnings- or price-triggered early release appears in the Underwriting text. 180 days after 2026-04-15 is 2026-10-12, so the restricted period ended with 2026-10-12 and the first session in which the locked stock was free was 2026-10-13 (stockanalysis.com's lock-up calendar independently lists ARXS at 'Oct 12, 2026', trigger '180 days after prospectus', 363.83M shares: https://stockanalysis.com/ipos/lockups/). Nasdaq's 10/13/2026 is one day late, and the baseline's 'first session strictly after' rule then lands on 2026-10-14, which is the SECOND free session. The whole lock-up (no staged tranche) was freed before today, so today is not the event and no findings are filed. The resale S-1 filed 2026-10-13 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2093536/000119312526419718/arxs-20261013.htm) is consistent with the lock-up having lapsed.

Borrow cost not found.
